title: Management of Addictions and Prevention in French Territorial Collectivities: The “PARADICT-O” Experience in Orleans CHU to Fight Burnout, Addictions and Sleep Disorders
content: Introduction: The URC PARADICT-O initiated the COVIDOR study; clinical research project in collaboration with the infectious diseases department of the CHRO (Orléans Regional Hospital Centre), the CHU of Tours and the University of Paris Saclay. More than 25% of the territorial agents were concerned by psychoactive drug abuse (alcohol, tobacco, cannabis or others…). Materials and methods: The addiction treatment pro-gram was a Level 2 program structured into four functional units. We decided in 2022 to transform the addiction unit in a level 3 program with PARADICT-O support with the university hospital program. Results: We include 7696 patients in 2019 and we reached 16 394 patients in 2025. We doubled the number of addictive patients in 7 years. Conclusions: In June 2026, the new addiction university service (Pr R Serreau) could take care of the regional Val de Loire centre population with the collaboration of Tours CHU to reduce the addiction prevalence with a public health challenge.
